result.reason: The redline supplies the preferred durations, conformance warranty, remedies, legal-compliance warranty, and malicious-code warranty. However, both levels require the professional-and-workmanlike warranty to cover Services generally, while the operative language covers only Hosting Services and Support Services and does not demonstrate that those are the entirety of the Services. Because that shared atomic requirement is unmet, neither level is complete. The additions otherwise preserve the existing terms and are not negated by the disclaimer, which excludes express warranties.
